rootCause: A newly entered Chinese SVG sample immediately used MiSans 600 before its Unicode shards loaded; font-display:swap then replaced fallback glyphs. Input composition also published candidates.
fix: Keep the native input draft immediate. Publish the committed SVG sample only after exact-weight FontFaceSet.load(text) resolves. Ignore obsolete requests, defer composition candidates, retain the last sample on font failure, and cap committed text at 18 grapheme clusters.
cache: 64 promise entries; native browser cache owns fetched/decoded fonts; no global font assets or preload changes
screenshotMethod: Isolated font-ready crops temporarily hide the fixed header only; lens is moved below text through normal arrow-key input. Final screenshots are ordinary full viewports.
limits: Synthetic composition events test application behavior. Physical iOS IME, native editor fallback painting and Combo Touch are not certified by this Windows test.
